title: User Workflow & Multi-User Security Hardening (v0.4.20)
message: Fixed multi-user session leaks on shared devices, enforced mandatory password updates on launch, enabled late enrollee reading material access, unhidden subject teacher performance analytics, and surfaced Phil-IRI Diagnostic Reading Tiers.
changelog:
• Multi-User & Shared Device Integrity: Scoped Apprentice Quest progress and active quiz states by user UID, ensuring zero cache leakage on shared school devices.
• Late Enrollee Access: Teacher material assignments now dynamically support late enrollees via section-level matching.
• Launch Security Gatekeepers: Enforced mandatory temporary password changes and educator authorization checks on cold start.
• Subject Teacher Performance: Unlocked class performance and learner analytics for subject teachers.
• Phil-IRI Diagnostic Tiers: Surfaced DepEd Phil-IRI reading diagnostic levels across teacher rosters, CSV exports, and scholar profile slips.
• Multi-Teacher Classroom Isolation: Scoped student join records to individual educators to prevent subject roster collisions.
